name: weildbuild-server
description: WeildBuild platform servers: Main Server (REST API + orchestration), Realtime (presence/chat), Game Host (game instances). Deploys to Render, database on Neon. v1.3 adds admin settings + overview API for WB Admin CTRL; v1.3.1 makes database setup fully automatic on boot (Render Shell is no longer needed - it became a paid feature).
//: BUILD FIX v1.2.0: prisma, typescript, tsx and @types/* live in dependencies ON PURPOSE. Render builds run with NODE_ENV=production, and npm silently skips devDependencies in that mode — that is what broke the v1.1 deploy (TS7016: no declaration file for 'express'). Do NOT move them back to devDependencies.

scripts.setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
